outcome.text: The selected sources support updating the label guidance: Trial A was approved at 42 words, the curator requested 35–50 words, and Trial B was unread at 190 words. Trial C shows that fitting the limit does not establish factual accuracy; the specimen record provides no evidence of a wild pollinator. Routine observations also suggest prioritizing the first sentence and large-print species name. I recorded the analysis and updated the memory and label method. This bounded pass leaves other coverage unexplored.
